roles.summary: Define the narrow causal boundary and dependency-aware design before implementation.
roles.stopping_condition: Return a bounded design with explicit preserved behavior, unresolved evidence and validation gates; do not implement unless assigned.

roles.summary: Apply an accepted narrow change in the canonical workspace and validate it proportionally.
include: accepted design or current task capsule
exclude: evidence already distilled into an unchallenged accepted finding
roles.stopping_condition: Focused checks pass, relevant broader gates pass, current state is updated, and runtime-sensitive status remains FIXED-PENDING-RUNTIME until replay proof.

roles.summary: Falsify the patch against task acceptance and protected behavior with the cheapest sufficient tests first.
exclude: implementation history not needed to form a failing case
roles.stopping_condition: Report exact PASS/FAIL commands and failures; distinguish structural coverage from runtime proof.

roles.summary: Adversarially inspect a proposed patch against the stated causal claim, ownership/state invariants and regression boundary.
roles.stopping_condition: Triage every finding as ACCEPTED, REJECTED with evidence, or DEFERRED; do not repeat review without changed evidence/design.

roles.summary: Reconstruct verified replay lifecycles without changing behavior or confusing telemetry with closure.
include: relevant diagnostic code map and prior accepted findings
exclude: superseded hypotheses unless new evidence challenges the accepted finding
roles.stopping_condition: Account for reconstructable successes, failures and unresolved cases; identify the first causal boundary and persist evidence/status before proposing a fix.
